text:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick sync — we need a final plan for the cloud-partner ref-arch + Terraform modules for the Marketplace listing. Goal: 1) reproducible quickstart, 2) CI that publishes versioned artifacts to partner registry, 3) smoke acceptance tests so partners can validate on their side. I sketched an outline in the doc: https://go.redwood/internal/partner-refarch (draft).

Jonah Lee: Sounds good. Couple of constraints to call out up front: marketplace images must be signed, and partner infra must support both NVIDIA (A100/RTX-class) and Ampere/ARM instances depending on region. We should make GPU node pools optional vars.

Rachel Kim: I can standardize the module interface. Proposal: root module exposes: var.cloud (aws|azure|gcp), var.instance_tier (dev|prod), var.enable_gpu = false, and outputs: module_registry_path, example_deploy_cmd. Keep modules composable — a 'platform' module that wires network + autoscaling + optional gpu_pool module.

Sandeep Patel: Packaging notes for Marketplace: artifact must be a tarball with checksum + semver tag, and CI should publish to partner-artifacts.s3 / az artifacts. Also need a companion 'deploy-quickstart' that runs a Terraform apply against a partner sandbox subscription + runs smoke tests (health endpoint, inference test with small prompt).

Maria Gonzalez: Great. Can we get a tiny example snippet in the thread so docs show how to opt into GPU? That will help partners copy/paste.

Jonah Lee: Yup — example below (very small):

```hcl
module "redwood_refarch" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/refarch-modules//marketplace-root?ref=v0.1.0"

  cloud          = var.cloud
  instance_tier  = var.instance_tier
  enable_gpu     = true
  gpu_instance   = "ND96asr_v4" # azure A100-ish SKU
  tags = {"redwood:partner" = "acme"}
}
```

Rachel Kim: Thanks — we'll include `gpu_instance` as a string var with a map of recommended SKUs per cloud in README. Also add a `compatibility_matrix.md` listing tested SKUs and sequence length perf notes.

Sandeep Patel: CI checklist I propose:
- lint + fmt
- run terraform init + validate
- terraform plan against ephemeral sandbox (with mock creds)
- build artifact tarball + compute sha256
- publish artifact to partner registry (dry-run flag)
- run smoke acceptance (container deploy + /health + generate prompt)

Maria Gonzalez: Perfect. Who can own the initial pipeline? I can shepherd partner review but need an eng owner for the pipeline and infra tests.

Rachel Kim: I can pick up the pipeline (GitHub Actions) and the module API. ETA: 2 weeks for the first pass. I'll stub the matrix and README.

Jonah Lee: I'll share the sku/testing spreadsheet and set up a quick sandbox (region eu-west-2 + us-east-1) for the acceptance tests.

partners-bot: Reminder: partner enablement review meeting scheduled Thu 09:30 PT. Agenda: ref-arch module draft, CI gating, publishing workflow.

Maria Gonzalez: Awesome — action items: Rachel (module + GH Actions) // Jonah (sandbox + SKU sheet) // Sandeep (CI publish + smoke harness) // Maria (partner review coordination). I'll send calendar invite and attach draft docs. :thumbsup:

Rachel Kim: Quick note — we should add a small example app that calls the Redwood hosted endpoint and fails gracefully if quota enforced. That will help partners demo end-to-end.

Sandeep Patel: Agreed. I'll add a tiny Python script in examples/that runs an inference call and asserts token count + latency < threshold.

Maria Gonzalez: Thanks all — let's post PRs to `github.com/redwood/partner-refarch` and tag @partners-team when ready.

Jonah Lee: /me thumbs up :rocket:
